lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: The GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES fence is delivered as a runtime process.env mutation

nextStoryContext: US-R1-003 closed the WARNING review finding at test/helpers/test-tmpdir.ts:86: the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES fence is delivered as a runtime process.env mutation, so it only protects a child git spawn that forwards live process.env, and src/commands/sidecar.ts:3091/3184/3186/3188 (checkoutMainFn/proceedBranchFn) call Bun.spawnSync(['git', ...]) with no env option -- confirmed empirically (not just per the finding's claim) that Bun.spawnSync/Bun.spawn do NOT live-inherit a process.env mutation made after process startup unless env: process.env is passed explicitly (a probe: process.env.X set at runtime, then Bun.spawnSync(['printenv','X']) with no env option prints nothing; with env: process.env it prints the value). Implemented the location-independent fix the finding itself recommended over patching every spawn site: test/helpers/test-tmpdir.ts's ensureScratchRoot() now calls a new ensureScratchRootIsAGitRepo() (idempotent -- skipped once SCRATCH_ROOT/.git exists, best-effort -- tolerates a missing/unusable git binary) that runs `git init -q <SCRATCH_ROOT>` once per process, the first time the scratch root is initialized. Because SCRATCH_ROOT now always carries its own .git, any git command run from a subdirectory with no .git of its own (the exact scenario the finding warned about: 'a future test driving [sidecar.ts's resolvers] with a non-initialized scratch cwd') resolves ITS toplevel to SCRATCH_ROOT and stops there, structurally, regardless of whether GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES reached that child's environment -- proved with a bare Bun.spawn(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],{cwd: scratchSubdir}) (deliberately no env key, matching sidecar.ts's exact call shape) resolving to SCRATCH_ROOT, never cam-cli's real repo. Deliberately did NOT touch src/commands/sidecar.ts (the finding's own suggested fix explicitly 'does not depend on every spawn site remembering to forward env', so patching sidecar.ts's 4 call sites would be optional defense-in-depth, not the actual fix, and was left out per Surgical Changes -- scope stayed inside the file the finding named). GOTCHA discovered while validating: GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES and the new stub .git interact non-obviously when a spawn site DOES forward env: process.env's own git docs (confirmed via fetch to git-scm.com) say a ceiling directory that is a STRICT ANCESTOR of the search start is respected by stopping the walk BEFORE that ancestor is even checked (distinct from the ceiling being the exact start dir, which IS still checked) -- so GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=SCRATCH_ROOT (a strict ancestor of every mkdtempSync child) still makes an env-forwarding spawn fail 'not a git repository' exactly as before this story (SCRATCH_ROOT's own .git is walked past, not walked into); this is still fully safe (never resolves into cam-cli's root), just a DIFFERENT exit shape than the no-env-forwarded case (which now succeeds and resolves to SCRATCH_ROOT). test/helpers/test-tmpdir.test.ts pins BOTH shapes as two separate tests (env-forwarded: unchanged 'not a git repository' assertion; env-NOT-forwarded, the new regression coverage: resolves to SCRATCH_ROOT, realpathSync-compared against both SCRATCH_ROOT and REPO_ROOT) rather than collapsing them into one incorrect universal expectation. Full bun test: 6069 pass / 0 fail (net +1 vs. 6068 baseline: one new test added, one pre-existing test's assertion updated in place -- see the two test.skipIf(!gitAvailable) blocks in test-tmpdir.test.ts). bun run typecheck clean. bun run check:all fully green (coverage, file-size, debt-markers, dead-code, dup, lint, embed-vendor, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, test-tmpdir, skip-ratchet) -- no _ref raise needed on file-size-budget.json/coverage-budget.json (both touched test files stayed small; test-tmpdir.ts coverage line dipped to 89.58% function/line but stayed inside the global floor, gate reported ok). Next agent should check prd.json for the next non-passing, non-operator story after US-R1-003.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Fetched to confirm an empirically-observed interaction between the new stub-.git fence and the existing GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES var before pinning it in a test. Docs confirm: a ceiling directory that is a strict ancestor of the search's starting directory is respected by Git NOT chdir'ing up into it (the walk stops before that ancestor's own .git is ever checked), while a ceiling directory that equals the exact starting directory does NOT act as a ceiling (git still checks it). This matches the empirical result: GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=SCRATCH_ROOT (a strict ancestor of every scratch subdir) still fails 'not a git repository' even after SCRATCH_ROOT itself gained a .git, because the ceiling stops the walk short of ever reaching it.
